description: Change the title, description (null clears it) or visibility of a playlist, or make it a row of the author's site (site_section, site_order). Send only what changes.

is_public.description: false: only the owner sees the playlist

site_order.description: Row position on the site, smallest first; null for none

site_section.description: Own row (section) on the author's site; a row is public. false removes the row.

name: update_playlist
title: Update a playlist
